# Exposure & gamma

Exposure in photographic stops, a black-level offset and a gamma curve, applied in linear light before tone mapping, like adjusting a camera rather than a screenshot.

<EffectDemo effect="exposure-gamma" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { exposureGamma } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/exposure-gamma';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(exposureGamma({ preset: 'brighter' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.exposure = 0`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type   | Default | Range      | Description                                          |
| ---------- | ------ | ------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `exposure` | number | `0`     | -5 – 5 EV  | Each stop doubles (or halves) the light.             |
| `gamma`    | number | `1`     | 0.2 – 5    | Above 1 lifts the midtones; below 1 deepens them.    |
| `offset`   | number | `0`     | -0.2 – 0.2 | Added in linear light: raises or crushes the blacks. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                       |
| ---------- | ------------------------------ |
| `brighter` | `exposure: 1`                  |
| `darker`   | `exposure: -1`                 |
| `lifted`   | `gamma: 1.4`                   |
| `crushed`  | `gamma: 0.75`, `offset: -0.01` |

Apply one with `exposureGamma({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.3 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 0.0 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 5.3 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/exposure-gamma`, including the shared effect runtime.
